subject: Re: Scheduling throughput kickoff for Dedicated capacity — NeonHealth

From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@neonhealth.ai>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: scheduling@neonhealth.ai
Date: 2028-03-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: Dedicated capacity demo — throughput kickoff

Hi Ben,

We signed up via the self-serve flow and got routed to an SDR — thanks for the quick follow-up. Our team at NeonHealth is evaluating Dedicated capacity for an internal triage model. Key constraints: ~400 concurrent sessions (mostly short calls), median request size ~150 tokens, P95 latency target < 200ms, and sustained QPS around 180.

Would like a short technical kickoff focused on throughput and routing/fallbacks before we book an eval cluster. Juliana (copied) will coordinate schedulers. I've attached a sample traffic export and a spreadsheet with rough volume numbers.

Attachments: neon_traffic_sample.csv (csv), dedicated_throughput_requirements.xlsx (xlsx stub)

Best,
Sanjay
Director of Platform Engineering
NeonHealth

From: ben_carter@redwood.com <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@neonhealth.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com
Date: 2028-03-15T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Dedicated capacity demo — throughput kickoff

Thanks for the details, Sanjay — really helpful. I’m Ben (SDR) — happy to run the scheduling and make sure the right engineers are on the call. Quick asks so we make the kickoff efficient:

- Can you confirm whether the 400 concurrent sessions are steady-state or bursty (peak windows)?
- Do you have a preferred region (we have Dedicated pilots in us-west/us-east/eu-west)?
- Any data residency constraints?

Proposed slots (PT):
- Thu Mar 16, 10:00–10:30 PT (30m) — Ops + AE + Solutions engineer
- Thu Mar 16, 15:00–15:45 PT (45m) — Ops + deeper Q&A
- Fri Mar 17, 09:00–09:30 PT (30m) — short sync

I’ve looped in Irene (runtime/product infra lead) and Marissa (AE) so we can cover kernel/quantization options and the rollout process. If you want a longer ops-heavy session, we can add Karthik (solutions) — tagging him for availability.

If any of these work, reply with the slot and timezone and I’ll send a calendar invite + HubSpot link.

—Ben C.
SDR, Redwood Inference

From: Juliana Morris <juliana@neonhealth.ai>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com
Date: 2028-03-15T13:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Dedicated capacity demo — throughput kickoff

Hi Ben / team,

Thanks — apologies, Sanjay is in APAC travel this week. The 400 concurrent sessions are peak-concurrency during business hours (we expect 6–8 hour sustained windows but with clear daily peaks). Region preference: us-west. No special residency restrictions beyond standard PHI controls — we’ll share the compliance questionnaire separately if needed.

The Thu Mar 16 15:00–15:45 PT slot works best for our platform and ops folks. Could you add Karthik or a Solutions Engineer who can run through batching, KV cache strategies, and quantization tradeoffs? Also please include expected artifacts (latency profiles, sample kernel configs) so our infra lead can pre-read.

Calendly ping: we received a scheduling token from scheduling@neonhealth.ai — Juliana will confirm once calendar invite shows up.

Juliana
Program Manager, NeonHealth
